description: fnd hook wiring for Codex — the canonical Claude Code hooks in Codex hooks.json envelope form (M1b measured live 2026-08-23: the top level is {description, hooks}, not a bare event map). Guards block by exit code; PostToolUse routes through codex-mcp-shim because Codex cannot rewrite tool output. The two PreToolUse guards are the ONE deliberate divergence from the verbatim Claude commands: they PROBE for the bundle (CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT, PLUGIN_ROOT, then the newest ~/.codex/plugins/cache/*/fnd/* holding the script) and, when nothing resolves, deny a git payload with exit 2 instead of running "/hooks/..." out of an empty root — which exits 127 and lets Codex proceed. Cursor's wiring denies the same case, OpenCode's adapter throws. The second PreToolUse group is the scratch-path guard (M3): the Claude command and matcher verbatim, modulo the root expansion. That matcher is prefix-agnostic on BOTH hosts on purpose — Codex names an MCP tool mcp__<server>__<tool> with the server name from mcp-codex.json, without the plugin_fnd_ prefix Claude Code adds, and on Claude Code the same two servers are often installed per-user rather than from the plugin. The guard denies through permissionDecision JSON (fail-open on everything else), which is why this one command keeps its `|| true`. The THIRD PreToolUse group is the spill-access recorder, which is MEASUREMENT ONLY and therefore the one PreToolUse command that never denies: it uses the same bundle probe, but when nothing resolves it exits 0 rather than blocking, and its matcher carries Codex's shell spellings alongside Read/Grep. Every command also exports FND_HOST=codex, the host column of the FND_HOST_TRACE log, and the SessionStart command ends with a "$r/hooks/host-trace.sh" SessionStart session-start inject call — the injection itself is a shell command here, so nothing else could record that it fired (2>/dev/null; true keeps a missing helper from changing what the session start prints or returns).

hooks.command: export FND_HOST=codex; r="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; echo "fnd plugin root: $r"; for f in comment-discipline plugin-feedback task-workspace untrusted-content mcp-whale; do cat "$r/hooks/$f.md" 2>/dev/null; done; if [ -f shopify.theme.toml ] || [ -f .env ]; then cat "$r/hooks/store-access.md" 2>/dev/null; fi; [ "${FND_LEAN:-1}" = "0" ] || cat "$r/hooks/lean-code.md" 2>/dev/null; "$r/hooks/host-trace.sh" SessionStart session-start inject 2>/dev/null; true

export FND_HOST=codex; r=""; for c in "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" "${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}"; do [ -n "$c" ] && [ -f "$c/hooks/no-ai-attribution.sh" ] && { r="$c"; break; }; done; if [ -z "$r" ]; then for c in "$HOME"/.codex/plugins/cache/*/fnd/*; do [ -f "$c/hooks/no-ai-attribution.sh" ] || continue; if [ -z "$r" ] || [ "$c" -nt "$r" ]; then r="$c"; fi; done; fi; if [ -n "$r" ]; then "$r/hooks/no-ai-attribution.sh"; else case "$(cat)" in *git*|*commit*|*push*|*merge*|*pull*) echo "fnd commit guard: hooks/no-ai-attribution.sh could not be located (CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT, PLUGIN_ROOT, ~/.codex/plugins/cache/*/fnd/*), so this git command is blocked rather than run unchecked. Re-install or repair the fnd plugin, then re-run the same command." >&2; exit 2 ;; esac; fi

export FND_HOST=codex; r=""; for c in "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" "${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}"; do [ -n "$c" ] && [ -f "$c/hooks/no-verify-bypass.sh" ] && { r="$c"; break; }; done; if [ -z "$r" ]; then for c in "$HOME"/.codex/plugins/cache/*/fnd/*; do [ -f "$c/hooks/no-verify-bypass.sh" ] || continue; if [ -z "$r" ] || [ "$c" -nt "$r" ]; then r="$c"; fi; done; fi; if [ -n "$r" ]; then "$r/hooks/no-verify-bypass.sh"; else case "$(cat)" in *git*|*commit*|*push*|*merge*|*pull*) echo "fnd commit guard: hooks/no-verify-bypass.sh could not be located (CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT, PLUGIN_ROOT, ~/.codex/plugins/cache/*/fnd/*), so this git command is blocked rather than run unchecked. Re-install or repair the fnd plugin, then re-run the same command. Never bypass the repo git hooks (--no-verify, core.hooksPath, HUSKY=0) - they are quality gates." >&2; exit 2 ;; esac; fi

export FND_HOST=codex; [ "${FND_SPILL_ACCESS:-1}" = "0" ] && exit 0; r=""; for c in "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" "${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}"; do [ -n "$c" ] && [ -f "$c/hooks/spill-access.sh" ] && { r="$c"; break; }; done; if [ -z "$r" ]; then for c in "$HOME"/.codex/plugins/cache/*/fnd/*; do [ -f "$c/hooks/spill-access.sh" ] || continue; if [ -z "$r" ] || [ "$c" -nt "$r" ]; then r="$c"; fi; done; fi; [ -z "$r" ] || "$r/hooks/spill-access.sh"; exit 0
